meta.title: feat: implement batched parallel processing for user availability calculation
meta.body_summary: Replace sequential user availability calls with batched parallel processing (8 users/batch, 100ms delay) to reduce end-to-end latency from minutes to seconds for teams with many users.

perf_labels.notes: Devin introduced batched parallel availability processing with numerical speedup claim; no human review occurred, bot closed due to 7+ days inactivity.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: Small 79-line edit confined to one file; as a targeted performance refactor it could have been low-risk, but it was closed due to lack of engagement rather than size or technical issues.

review_details.concern_detail: PR received zero human reviews; only bot comments. Devin bot auto-closed after more than 7 days of inactivity.
review_details.performance_claim: Reduce user availability calculation from sequential 80-200 seconds to batched parallel 3-8 seconds for 40 users.
review_details.rejection_signals: Bot auto-closed due to inactivity; no human objection or approval.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Agent delivered a low-risk, single-file batching change with numerical speedup claims, but no human reviewer engaged. The PR eventually auto-closed, highlighting a process gap for agent-authored perf PRs that lack maintainer response.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No benchmarks, profiling, or reproducible test steps; only narrative expected performance numbers.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No human review; Devin bot closed after inactivity without any fix-in-PR cycle.

core_change_summary.description: In packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/slots/util.ts, introduced getUsersAvailabilityWithBatching that processes users in batches of 8 with 100ms inter-batch delay via Promise.all, replacing the sequential getUsersAvailability call. Added logging and fallback to individual processing on batch failure.
change_trajectory: Single commit adding batching function and modifying calculateHostsAndAvailabilities to use it.

Vercel bot reported skipped deployments for cal and cal-eu.
Devin bot closed PR due to inactivity after 7 days.

Multiple bots (Devin intro, Vercel deployment, Delve security) commented, but no human reviewer engaged.
